game.name: Sims 3, The
game.desc:
The Sims 3 is a handheld game, developed by Electronic Arts for the Nintendo DS handheld system.
For the first time ever, players can experience a full life simulation on a handheld with Nintendo DS. However, Sims are unable to age, WooHoo, or have children. The neighborhood in the game is Beacon Bay, and many familiar Sims and/or relatives, such as Malcolm Landgraab and Alexander Goth, appear.
